verdict.rationale: Steel is an API-first browser service whose Sessions API lets agents spin up isolated browsers on demand. It is also driveable via Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium over CDP, and it publishes an OpenAPI spec. The official CLI runs full browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal, and a pre-built Docker image supports self-hosted automation, so non-interactive programmatic operation is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples or non-interactive auth via env vars for the CLI), and independent hands-on reports of running Steel in CI.
